description: This script is designed to process and clean a generated Python code file related to Triton kernel code, removing dependencies and automating launch parameter generation.

methods.name: remove_triton_function_declaration
methods.description: Removes Triton function declarations from source code.

methods.name: remove_async_compile
methods.description: Removes async compile related code snippets.

methods.name: rename_kernels
methods.description: Renames kernel functions based on regex matches.

methods.name: merge_params
methods.description: Merges original and new parameter lists, replacing 'T' with original parameters.

methods.name: add_launch_params
methods.description: Replaces function calls with launch parameters and removes inductor wrappers.

methods.name: process_file
methods.description: Main processing function that reads, transforms, and writes code, including generating launch parameters if needed.

methods.name: get_clean_triton
methods.description: Entry point to process input file and output cleaned Triton code.
